snippet_primary: "I was supporting a content provider on YouTube named The Next Layer. I sent my money to this crooked website and I'm still not able to get access to the content promised. The site is totally devoid of any place to contact them. The YouTube channel for the content provider has a Gestapo AI that will not allow any questions outside of the video content. I don't know if they know that this rip off provider is affecting their business. I'm done with them. I would suggest staying away from patreon!"
